counterfactual_missing_items: CD99 membranous staining pattern not specified
decisive_items: small, round hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, frequent mitoses
response.rationale: R2 matches the small round cell morphology, pseudo-rosettes, and diffuse CD99 positivity, with negative keratin/desmin/WT-1 excluding carcinoma, DSRCT, and rhabdomyosarcoma. C1/R5 only provide broad anatomic uterine sarcoma without the specific histologic/IHC profile. R1, R4, and R6 are contradicted by the same raw spans.

rejected.why: Correlated restatement of C1 with less anatomical completeness; lacks histologic/IHC specificity.
SFT does not explain small round cells/pseudo-rosettes; KIT positivity is against SFT and CD99/cyclin D1 are nonspecific.
DSRCT requires keratin/desmin/WT-1 positivity, all of which are negative.
GIST is excluded by DOG1 negativity, uterine/retroperitoneal location, and small round cell morphology with diffuse CD99.
